summary: Hepsiburada (D-MARKET Electronic Services & Trading, NASDAQ: HEPS) filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release dated November 5, 2026. Results are restated under IAS 29 hyperinflation accounting: GMV fell 6.6% to TRY 62.0bn and revenue fell 6.1% to TRY 24,264.9m, while IAS 29-unadjusted GMV rose 22.3%. Orders grew 0.7% to 20.3m, active customers rose 1.9% to 11.5m, and marketplace share of GMV reached 69.8%. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are present; no deal terms apply.
